attack: Initial authority and action bindings are valid, but the required fresh authority resolver raises an exception when called at the consequence boundary.
bounded_finding: Under frozen deterministic P2-H09, failure of the required fresh-authority resolver at the consequence boundary did not authorize execution.
nonclaim: This establishes only the frozen deterministic resolver-exception behavior of the tested permit/firewall/broker path. It does not establish behavior for every authority service outage, distributed failure mode, or production deployment.
